question: Which media type is used by the most tracks?
sql: SELECT m.Name FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Monthly invoice count in 2010
sql: SELECT CAST(strftime('%m', InvoiceDate) AS INTEGER) AS month, COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2010-01-01' AND InvoiceDate < '2011-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: Customers with no invoices
sql: SELECT c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName FROM Customer c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Invoice i WHERE i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId)
